from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u093/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-66a8d999.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    if not wall_rows:
        raise ValueError("missing wall")
    wall = wall_rows[0]
    dr = 1 if wall == h - 1 else -1
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)}
    components = []
    while cells:
        start = next(iter(cells))
        todo = [start]
        cells.remove(start)
        comp = {start}
        while todo:
            r, c = todo.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in cells:
                    cells.remove(q)
                    comp.add(q)
                    todo.append(q)
        components.append(comp)
    components.sort(key=lambda comp: min(r for r,c in comp) if dr < 0 else -max(r for r,c in comp))
    out = [[2 if grid[r][c] == 2 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    occupied = set()
    for comp in components:
        moved = set(comp)
        while True:
            nxt = {(r+dr,c) for r,c in moved}
            if any(r < 0 or r >= h or c < 0 or c >= w for r,c in nxt) or nxt & occupied or any(grid[r][c] == 2 for r,c in nxt):
                break
            moved = nxt
        occupied |= moved
        for r,c in moved:
            out[r][c] = grid[next(iter(comp))[0]][next(iter(comp))[1]]
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(program_path),'exec'),globals())
